blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.
blocks.zh: 现实世界的决策问题结合了两种性质不同的制约:必须满足的要求,称为硬约束,以及可以被侵犯的偏好,称为软约束. 由于这些问题常常被自然语言的决策者所提出,因此大型语言模型为协助解决它们提供了一个自然工具. 这导致了自发化,它侧重于使用LLMS将决定问题的自然语言描述翻译为可执行的数学优化模型. 然而,这一研究往往忽略了软性限制,如消费者、管理人员和规划者提出的那些限制,尽管许多实际问题需要明确加以示范。 我们引入了ASTOR,一个推论-时间框架,将自然语言决定问题映射到由语法指导的抽象语法树(AST)上,然后确定将由此产生的表达性汇编成可执行优化代码. 我们还引入了SoftOR,这是自然语言问题的统一基准,侧重于软约束的表达. 在Softor上,ASTOR在可比较的单向求取和多代理LLM方法中实现了最佳的集合精度,同时在仅包含硬性约束的标准自发基准上保持竞争力. 编码和数据见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In practical settings, decision-makers often have to balance preferences from many stakeholders, some of which are not always satisfiable. These preferences do not constrain their decisions the same way that a strict requirement might. For example, a hospital manager must assign nurses to cover every shift, but may accommodate preferences to avoid night shifts or maintain consecutive days off. A travel agent must choose hotels and flights that obey the requested destination, but may not always be able to accommodate brand preferences. A shopping agent must obey the consumer’s budget, but may choose to suggest a longer delivery date than the one desired. An ideal optimization model must therefore distinguish what must hold from what is preferred to hold, and when preferences conflict, determine which take priority.
blocks.zh: 在实际环境中,决策者往往必须平衡来自许多利益攸关方的偏好,其中一些并非总能令人满意。 这些优惠并不象严格要求那样限制他们的决定。 例如,医院管理人员必须指派护士来承担每班工作,但可以照顾到避免上夜班或连续休假的偏好。 旅行社必须选择服从被请求目的地的酒店和航班,但可能并不总是能够容纳品牌偏好. 购物代理商必须服从消费者的预算,但可以选择提出比预期的更长交货日期。 因此,理想的优化模式必须区分什么是必须持有的,什么是最好持有的,在优惠发生冲突时,确定哪一个优先。

blocks.en: Natural language is a familiar way to express these distinctions, and the growing use of large language models (LLMs) makes it an increasingly common interface for decision-making. Consumers use AI tools for shopping and planning ( Associated Press, 2025 ; Shopify, 2026 ; McKinsey & Company, 2026 ) , while firms are incorporating AI for investments or as retail assistants ( The Wall Street Journal, 2026 ; Reuters, 2026 ) . These settings often present decision-makers with hard and soft constraints. As a result, LLM autoformulation provides a promising approach for this translation problem. Research in this field often uses LLM prompting or fine-tuning methods to successfully translate natural-language descriptions of real decision problems into solvable mathematical optimization formulations. However, their methods often prioritize only hard formulations ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) and current benchmarks only test those formulations ( Ramamonjison et al., 2022 ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025a ) . They do not directly test whether a model distinguishes requirements from preferences or preserves the ordering among preferences. This leaves an important class of practical decision problems without a strong autoformulation method or evaluation tools.
blocks.zh: 自然语言是表达这些区别的一种熟悉的方法,而大型语言模型(LLMS)的日益被使用,使得它成为决策的日益常见的界面. 消费者使用AI工具进行购物和规划(美联社,2025;Shoppify,2026;McKinsey & Company,2026),而公司则将AI纳入投资或作为零售助理("华尔街日报",2026;"路透社",2026. 这些环境往往使决策者受到硬和软的限制。 因此,LLM自成型为这个翻译问题提供了一个很有希望的方法. 这一领域的研究经常使用LLM提示法或微调法来将真实决策问题的自然语言描述成功翻译为可溶解的数学优化配方. 然而,其方法往往只优先使用硬制剂(Wei等,2022;Deng等,2024;Yang等,2026),而目前的基准只测试这些制剂(Ramamonjison等,2022;AhmadiTeshnizi等,2024;Xiao等,2024;Huang等,2025a)。 它们并不直接检验一种模式是否将要求与优惠区分开来,也不直接检验是否保留了优惠之间的顺序。 这就留下了一个重要的类别的实际决策问题,没有强大的自发化方法或评价工具.

blocks.en: We address this gap with ASTOR and SoftOR. ASTOR is an inference-time method which prompts an LLM to express a decision problem as an abstract syntax tree generated by a formal grammar, then validates and compiles that representation deterministically into solver code. The constructed grammar is adequate for the class of hard and soft constraint optimization problems considered in this work; see Appendix C . SoftOR is our newly introduced benchmark for evaluating whether models can recover weighted-penalty and lexicographic soft-constraint formulations from natural language. It consists of tasks involving travel planning and scheduling nurses for shifts in a hospital.
blocks.zh: 我们与ASTOR和Softor一起解决这一差距。 ASTOR是一种推论-时间方法,它促使一个LLM将决策问题表达为由正文法生成的抽象语法树,然后验证并编译该表达定理为解码. 构建的语法足以解决本作所考虑的硬和软约束优化问题类别;见附录C. 软 OR是我们新采用的用于评估模型是否能够从自然语言中恢复加权惩罚和词汇软约束配方的基准。 它包括旅行规划和安排护士在医院轮班的任务。

blocks.en: Across the 355 SoftOR instances, ASTOR achieves 88.5% solution accuracy, compared with 84.8% for the strongest alternative. It achieves the highest accuracy on three of the four SoftOR datasets, with the nurse scheduling dataset as the only exception. On 435 conventional hard-constraint problems, ASTOR achieves 81.8%, within 0.5 percentage points of the best-performing method.
blocks.zh: 横跨355软 OR例,ASTOR实现88.5%的溶液精度,而最强替代品的精度为84.8%. 它在4个SoftOR数据集中的3个上实现了最高的精度,护士调度数据集是唯一的例外. 在435个常规的硬约束性问题上,ASTOR取得了81.8%的成绩,在最优方法的0.5个百分点以内.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Autoformulation. Autoformulation methods differ in both their output representation and their use of inference-time computation. Under a single-request budget, Direct prompting returns a final solution, Codegen produces an executable solver program, and Chain-of-Thought prompting generates a natural-language derivation before producing the program ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动造型. 自动形成方法在输出表示和使用推论时间计算方面各不相同. 在单一要求预算下,"Direct"促进返回最终解决方案,Codegen生成可执行的解析程序,"Cain-of-Thoughting"在制作程序前生成自然语言衍生(Deng等,2024;Wei等,2022;Yang等,2026).

blocks.en: Other systems improve autoformulation by adding training supervision or iterative inference. ORLM ( Huang et al., 2025a ) fine-tunes models on generated optimization instances, while LLMOPT ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) trains models to produce structured formulations before code generation. Chain-of-Experts, OptiMUS, and ORThought instead distribute interpretation, formulation, implementation, and correction across multiple agents or execution-conditioned stages ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . These methods demonstrate the value of additional supervision and refinement. Some methods use intermediate representations to organize formulation or code generation ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024 ) , but these representations are often not tailored to the task of optimization, nor do they admit any formal coverage guarantees. ASTOR uses the inference budget of the single-request methods and a bespoke formal representation designed for optimization formulations to produce more accurate models.
blocks.zh: 其他系统通过增加培训监督或迭代推论来改进自发化. ORLM (Huang等,2025a)对生成优化实例的模型进行微调,而LLMOPT (Jiang等,2025)则在代码生成前对模型进行微调以生成结构化配体. " 专家链 " 、 " OptiMUS " 和 " OrThought " 转而将解释、表述、执行和纠正分出多个代理人或执行阶段(萧等,2024年;艾哈迈迪·特什尼齐等,2024年;杨等,2026年)。 这些方法表明了额外监督和完善的价值。 一些方法使用中间表示法来组织配方或代码生成(Jiang等,2025;AhmadiTeshnizi等,2024),但这些表示法往往不适应优化的任务,也不承认任何正式的覆盖保障. ASTOR使用单一请求方法的推论预算,以及一个为优化配方而设计的有声正式代表,以产生更准确的模型.

blocks.en: Benchmarking. Autoformulation benchmarks evaluate whether a system can translate a natural-language problem into a solvable mathematical program. Early benchmarks focused on recovering standard linear programs from relatively structured descriptions, as in NL4Opt ( Ramamonjison et al., 2022 ) . Later work expanded the task to longer descriptions, mixed-integer programs, executable solver code, implicit constraints, and industrial problems ( AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Together, these benchmarks have moved evaluation toward more realistic and structurally diverse formulation tasks ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 制定基准。 自动格式化基准评价一个系统是否能够将自然语言问题转化为可溶解的数学程序. 早期的基准侧重于从相对结构化的描述中恢复标准线性程序,如NL4Opt(Rammonjison等,2022年). 后来的工作将任务扩大到更长的描述,混合集成程序,可执行的解码,隐含的限制,以及工业问题(Ahmadi Tethnizi等,2024;Huang等,2025b;Xiao等,2024;Huang等,2025a;Yang等,2026). 这些基准合在一起,使评价朝着更加现实和结构多样化的拟订任务(萧等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Evaluation methods differ by benchmark, but the most common kind is called solution accuracy ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . In this method, each natural language instance is labeled a priori with a gold-standard optimal value that the authors consider correct. This optimal value can be a number if there is a single objective function, or a vector if there are multiple. To score an LLM autoformulation attempt, evaluators can take the optimization model produced by an LLM for a single natural language instance, perform the optimization using a solver like Gurobi, and compare the optimal value produced by the LLM’s optimization formulation to the gold-standard value. The LLM’s attempt is scored as correct if and only if the optimal value produced by its formulation matches the gold-standard value within the specified numerical tolerance. Other methods use an LLM and graph methods like embedding distance or edit distance to score the optimization formulation itself, instead of just the optimal value Liu et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ; Abdul Rahman et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) . This paper uses solution accuracy as the primary evaluation metric, as well as some measures of formulation success.
blocks.zh: 评估方法因基准而异,但最常见的类型称为溶液精度(Jiang等,2025;Yang等,2026;AhmadiTeshnizi等,2024;Xiao等,2024). 在这个方法中,每个自然语言实例被贴上先验的标签,具有作者认为正确的黄金标准最佳值. 如果有一个单一的客观函数,这个最佳值可以是数字,如果有一个多重的矢量. 要对LLM的自成型尝试进行评分,评价人员可以取出由LLM为单一自然语言实例所制作的优化模型,使用Gurobi等解析器进行优化,并将LLM的优化配方所产生的最优化值与黄金标准值进行比较. LLM的尝试如果并且只有当其配制产生的最佳值与指定的数值耐受度范围内的黄金标准值相匹配时才会被评为正确。 其他方法使用LLM和图法如嵌入相距或编辑相距来给优化配方本身打分,而不只是刘等(2026年);张等(2026年);阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼等(2026年);李等(2025年);王等(2025年). 本文将溶液精度作为主要评价尺度,以及一些制定成功度量.

blocks.en: Related benchmarks such as TravelPlanner, COMPASS, and SchedulingBenchmarks Nurse Rostering contain requirements and preferences that may conflict ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2026 ; Curtois, 2014 ) . However, these are not well prepared for autoformulation benchmarking, because none jointly provides complete natural language instances with gold-standard labeled optimal values. Additionally, existing autoformulation benchmarks focus primarily on feasibility constraints and scalar objectives. SoftOR is the first of its kind to directly target soft constraint formulations.
blocks.zh: 相关基准如"旅行计划"(Travel Planner),"COMPAS"(COMPAS)和"Scheduling Benchmarks Nurse"(Schedoming Benchmarks) 名册编制包含可能相冲突的要求和偏好(谢等,2024;秦等,2026;Curtois,2014.). 然而,这些没有为自动制定基准做好充分准备,因为没有一个共同提供带有黄金标准标签的最佳值的完整的自然语言实例。 此外,现有的自动化基准主要侧重于可行性限制和尺度目标。 软 OR是首个直接瞄准软约束制剂的同类.

blocks.en: Formal Language in LLM Inference Formal languages have proven to be a useful intermediate step in other LLM translation tasks. Researchers have defined bespoke formal languages to successfully aid translation from natural language into formal logic or code, often representing the formulas produced in those languages through tree-graphs called Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) ( Aho et al., 2007 ; Alur et al., 2013 ; Padhi et al., 2023 ) . For example, NL2LOGIC uses a Backus–Naur Form grammar and AST representation to generate logical expressions that are translated into Boolean-solver code, reporting up to 99% syntactic faithfulness ( Putra et al., 2026 ) . AST-T5 and AST-based NL-to-SQL methods likewise use syntactic structure to support code generation ( Gong et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2026 ) , while AST-Probe finds recoverable code structure in language-model representations ( Hernández López et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 事实证明,正式语言是其他LLM翻译工作中有用的中间步骤。 研究人员已经界定了说出正式语言的定义,以便成功地协助将自然语言翻译成正式逻辑或代码,这些语言往往通过树图(ASTs)来代表以这些语言制作的公式(Aho等人,2007年;Alur等人,2013年;Padhi等人,2023年)。 例如,NL2LOGIC使用Backus-Naur Form语法和AST表达法生成逻辑表达法被翻译为Boolean-Solver代码,报告高达99%的合成忠实度(Putra等,2026年). AST-T5和AST基于NL-to-SQL的方法同样使用合成结构支持代码生成(Gong等,2024年;Liao等,2026年),而AST-Probe在语言模型表达法中发现可恢复的代码结构(Hernández López等,2022年).

blocks.en: Furthermore, the formal languages themselves often admit provable guarantees which are not accessible to other inference methods, and their computational representations as ASTs are useful for downstream formal evaluation such as graph embedding and isomorphism ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . These results motivate ASTs as an interface between language models and executable formal systems, especially NL2LOGIC, which even uses ASTs for LLM translation and deterministic solving. ASTOR applies that interface to optimization and newly extends it to represent hard constraints, weighted penalties, and lexicographic priorities.
blocks.zh: 此外,正式语言本身也往往接受其他推论方法无法使用的可证明的保障,其作为AST的计算表述对于下游正式评价如图嵌入和同位素论(Li等,2025;Wang等,2025等)很有用. 这些结果激励了AST作为语言模型与可执行的正式系统之间的接口,特别是NL2LOGIC,它甚至使用AST进行LLM翻译和确定解析. ASTOR将该接口用于优化,并新近将其扩展为硬约束,加权处罚和词典优先事项.

blocks.en: 3.2 Formal Grammar
blocks.zh: 3.2 正式语法

blocks.en: The formal grammar G G defines the intermediate language at the center of our method. G G provides compositional rules to assemble variables, domains, numbers, expressions, formulas, boolean connectives, aggregations, and explicit priority levels into formulas that represent optimization models. This grammar is given to our method as its output language, which guides it to create well-formed formulas in a language we know to be well-suited for optimization with soft constraints. Other methods, which output in natural language or solver-code, do not provide a bespoke formal representation designed for a specific optimization task. Our method will do this through the use of a formal grammar.
blocks.zh: 正式的语法GG定义了中间语言在我们方法的中心. GG提供组成规则来组装变量,域,数字,表达式,公式,布尔连接,集合,以及明确的优先级,以形成代表优化模型的公式. 这种语法被赋予我们的方法作为它的输出语言,它指导它用一种我们知道很适合用软约束来优化的语言来创建成型的公式. 其他方法以自然语言或解码输出,并不能提供为特定优化任务而设计的有声正式表示. 我们的方法将通过使用正式的语法来做到这一点.

blocks.en: However, the grammar used by our method does achieve one such guarantee. In particular, we use a notion of adequacy , which is a standard notion in formal logic for establishing that a formal language can represent its intended class of structures ( Cheney et al., 2012 ; Otto, 2013 ) . In our case, G G is adequate for the class of optimization problems considered in this work when the correspondence holds in both directions: every well-formed formula generated by G G denotes a problem in the class, and every problem in the class can be represented by a well-formed formula generated by G G . Thus, the grammar admits exactly the target problems without admitting any outside formulas ( Cheney et al., 2012 ; Otto, 2013 ) . Appendix C gives the complete grammar, formal definition, and proof.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的方法所使用的语法确实实现了一种这样的保证。 特别是,我们使用适足性的概念,这是形式逻辑中的一个标准概念,用以确定一种正式语言能够代表其预定的结构类别(Cheney等人,2012年;Otto,2013年)。 就我们而言,G G 足以应付本作中考虑的优化类问题,当函证双向存在时:G 产生的每一个完善的公式都表示本作中的问题,而本作中的每一个问题都可以由G G 产生的一个完善的公式来代表. 因此,语法完全承认目标问题,而没有承认任何外部公式(Cheney等,2012年;Otto,2013年)。 附 录 C给出了完整的语法,形式定义和证明.

blocks.en: 3.3 ASTOR Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.3 ASTOR 示范建筑

blocks.en: Figure 1: ASTOR: One LLM call forms an AST which is compiled and solved deterministically.
blocks.zh: 图1:ASTOR:一个LLM调用构成一个AST,由编译和解析决定.

blocks.en: Our method prompts an LLM with a natural-language problem and the grammar G G to produce a well-formed expression in the language generated by G G , which in this case is an optimization problem that may have hard or soft constraints. Every such expression admits a corresponding Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), a tree-structured representation that makes the compositional relationships between optimization components explicit. This gives our method a constrained intermediate representation between natural language and executable optimization code. AST-based intermediate representations have been used in natural-to-formal language translation to reduce generation errors and enforce compositional consistency ( Putra et al., 2026 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Hernández López et al., 2022 ) . We adapt this approach to mathematical optimization, and develop a typed grammar, which is more expressive than some first-order-logic grammars developed in previous AST papers. For this reason, we name our method ASTOR : Abstract Syntax Trees for Operations Research.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法促使一个具有自然语言问题的LLM和语法GG在由G所生成的语言中生成一个成型良好的表达,在这种情况下,这是一个可能具有硬性或软性约束的优化问题. 每个这样的表达式都承认相应的抽象语法树(AST),一种树结构化的表示式,使优化组件之间的组成关系明确. 这使得我们的方法在自然语言和可执行性优化代码之间具有受限的中间代表. 基于AST的中间表示法被用在了自然到正式语言翻译中来减少生成错误并强制实施成分一致性(Putra等,2026;Gong等,2024;Liao等,2026;Hernández López等,2022). 我们把这个方法适应数学优化,并发展出一种打字的语法,它比以前AST论文所发展出的一些一阶-逻辑语法更有表现力. 为此,我们命名我们的方法ASTOR:抽象语法树用于操作研究.

blocks.en: The specific implementation is in Figure 1 . Concretely, the model is given a prompt including a brief description of the task, the formal grammar, and a JSON schema which serializes the AST and is the expected output form. The AST-JSON contains variable declarations, hard constraints, soft constraints, and priority annotations. A deterministic post-processing pipeline applies only local JSON repairs, validates and parses the resulting tree, and compiles it into executable Gurobi code. Thus, the LLM is responsible for formulating the optimization problem, while all subsequent translation from the formal representation to solver code is deterministic. The resulting solver output is evaluated against the gold optimum. Worked examples and execution traces are provided in Appendix B , with complete prompts and execution rules in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 具体执行情况见图一。 具体来说,该模型得到了一个即时的提示,其中包括对任务的简单描述,正式的语法,以及一个JSON schema,将AST序列化,是预期的输出形式. AST-JSON包含可变声明,硬约束,软约束,和优先说明. 定型后处理管只应用了当地的JSON修复,验证并剖析所生树,并编译为可执行的古罗比码. 因此,LLM负责制定优化问题,而后从正式表示到解码的所有翻译都是决定性的. 对由此产生的解析器产出进行最佳金色评价。 附录B提供了工作实例和执行痕迹,附录D载有完整的提示和执行规则。

blocks.en: 4 Building a New Benchmark: SoftOR
blocks.zh: 4 制定新的基准: 软体

blocks.en: Existing LLM autoformulation benchmarks primarily evaluate feasibility and objective recovery for problems expressed through hard constraints. Existing datasets contain preferences, but do not jointly provide natural-language instances, verified gold optima, and annotations for both weighted-penalty and lexicographic objectives. We therefore introduce SoftOR (Soft Operations Research), a unified natural-language soft-constraint autoformulation benchmark covering both objective structures. To construct and annotate lexicographic instances, we draw on the theory of modality from linguistics, which studies expressions such as must , should , and may that describe necessity, obligation, and desire ( Henning et al., 2022 ; Garson, 2023 ) . These provide an immediate natural-language interface for soft constraints, and linguistic theory already motivates an ordering on modal words by strength that can be used to define lexicographic levels.
blocks.zh: 现有的LLM自动化基准主要评价可行性和通过硬性限制表达的问题的客观恢复。 现有数据集包含偏好,但不共同提供自然语言实例、经核实的黄金选取以及加权惩罚和词汇目标的说明。 因此,我们采用了SoftOR(软操作研究),这是一个统一的自然语言软约束自发化基准,涵盖两个客观结构. 为了构建和说明词汇学实例,我们借鉴了语言学模式理论,该理论研究诸如必须、应该、并且可能描述必要性、义务和欲望的表达方式(Henning等,2022;Garson,2023)。 这些为软约束提供了即时的自然语言界面,语言学理论已经激发出用强度对模式词进行排序,可用于定义词典水平.

blocks.en: SoftOR comprises Nurse Rostering, COMPASS, TravelPlanner, and LexiBench. For the first three components, we use published datasets as basic source material, but construct the natural-language instances, soft-constraint semantics, priority annotations, and evaluation rules required for autoformulation. LexiBench is entirely original. Table 1 summarizes the resulting components and identifies the source data used in their construction.
blocks.zh: SoftOR包括护士名册编制、COMPAS、旅行计划员和Lexi Bench。 对于前三个组件,我们使用已公布的数据集作为基本源材料,但构建出自然语言实例,软约束语义,优先权说明,以及自发化所需的评价规则. 莱克西·本奇完全是独创的. 表1汇总了由此产生的组成部分,并确定了其构建过程中所使用的来源数据。

blocks.zh: 表1:具有新的自然语言问题和评价的SoftOR组件。

blocks.zh: 包括自然语言提示在内的全部基准构建细节载于附录F。

blocks.en: 4.1 Constructing New SoftOR Autoformulation Instances from Source data
blocks.zh: 4.1 构造新软体自动格式 来源数据实例

blocks.en: The source data from Nurse Rostering, COMPASS, and TravelPlanner were designed for scheduling or planning evaluation rather than natural-language optimization autoformulation and were therefore not directly usable as SoftOR instances without our adaptations as described below.
blocks.zh: 护士名册、COMPAS和Travel Planner的原始数据是为了安排或规划评价,而不是自然语言优化的自成型,因此,没有下文所述的调整,不能作为SoftOR实例直接使用。

blocks.en: For Nurse Rostering, we convert published tabular requirements into new natural-language instances with explicit priority markers. Each published request weight becomes a fixed phrase. In particular, the original priority markers, annotated as 1, 2, 3, and 100, become “slightly prefers," “prefers," “strongly prefers" and “far more serious." The original numbers are not kept in the final natural language instance, since we intend to test whether these ordinal priorities can be recovered from language alone. Optima are provided by the original benchmark authors ( Curtois, 2014 ) . Numerical weights are not given to any method. Each method instantiates its own weights, if it chooses to use them, and the specific numerical weights given by the benchmark are used only post-modeling for scoring and evaluation. We chose not to show weights to any route during decision-making so we can evaluate each route’s ability to infer preference strength from natural language. As an ablation, we run a case where routes can see weights before decisions in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 就护士名册编制而言,我们把已公布的表格要求转换成新的自然语种,并有明确的优先标记。 每个已公布的请求权重成为固定短语. 特别是,最初的优先权标记被注为"1,2,3和100",变得"略为偏好","偏好","强烈偏好"和"更严重". 原始数字不保留在最终自然语言实例中,因为我们打算测试这些平分优先级是否可以单从语言中恢复. Optima由原基准作者提供(Curtois,2014.). 数字权重不给予任何方法. 每一种方法都会将自己的权重即时化,如果它选择使用的话,基准给出的具体数值权重只用于后建模来评分和评价. 我们选择在决策期间不给任何路线显示权重, 作为减让,我们办了一个案例,在附录F中,路线可以在作出决定之前看到权重。

blocks.en: The original COMPASS source material provided a natural-language query, structured hard constraints and preferences, a finite set of candidate plans, and one annotated gold plan ID ( Qin et al., 2026 ) . It did not present these elements as a single autoformulation instance or annotate the underlying optimization objective. To adapt these instances for SoftOR, we combine the query and structured fields into a complete natural-language problem using fixed templates that mark requirements as "required" and wishes as equally important soft constraints that are "preferred". We also reconstruct the gold objective. Because multiple plans may satisfy the same maximum number of preferences, we enumerate every provided plan and use that maximum as gold rather than requiring the single plan ID supplied originally by COMPASS.
blocks.zh: COMPAS的原始原始资料提供了自然语言查询,结构化的硬约束和偏好,一套有限的候选计划,以及一款附加说明的金计划ID(秦等,2026年). 它没有将这些要素作为单一的自定义实例,也没有说明基本的优化目标。 为了为SoftOR调整这些实例,我们将查询和结构化字段合并为一个完整的自然语言问题,使用固定的模板将要求标为"需要"并希望作为同等重要的软约束被"偏好". 我们还重建了黄金目标。 由于多个计划可能满足相同的最大偏好数量,我们列举了每一个提供的计划,并将这一最大偏好作为黄金使用,而不是要求最初由COMPAS提供的单一计划ID.

blocks.en: The original TravelPlanner source already provided natural-language travel-planning problems and structured candidate data, but it was designed to evaluate plan generation and does not supply annotated optimization formulations or gold objective vectors ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . For our adaptation, we convert each instance into a lexicographic autoformulation task by assigning its linguistic cues to three priority tiers. These cues, called modals , express obligation, intention, or desire, and the tiers follow the deontic–teleological–bouletic distinction in modal linguistics ( Rubinstein et al., 2013 ; von Fintel and Iatridou, 2008 ; Portner, 2009 ; Henning et al., 2022 ) : deontic language states what must hold, teleological language what the speaker plans to achieve, and bouletic language what the speaker wants. We then enumerate every valid combination of transport, one hotel per city, and restaurants; compare plans lexicographically by tier violations; and break ties by total cost. The resulting optimal vector is the gold annotation, and a formulation is correct only if its solution matches that vector at every tier and in cost. The complete inventory of linguistic cues and benchmark construction details is included in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 最初的"旅行计划"来源已经提供了自然语言的出行规划问题和结构化的候选数据,但旨在评价计划生成,不提供附加说明的优化配方或黄金目标矢量(Xie等,2024年). 为了适应我们的需要,我们把每个实例转化为一个词典自动化任务,将其语言提示分配给三个优先层次。 这些被称为模式、明示义务、意图或愿望的提示,以及层次遵循模式语言学中的代词-语音-bouletic区分(Rubinstein等,2013年;von Fintel和Iatridou,2008年;Portner,2009年;Henning等,2022年) : 代词表达的是必须持有的,演讲者计划实现的远程语言,以及演讲者想要的bouletic语言。 然后,我们逐一列举交通、每个城市一个旅馆和餐馆等各种有效的组合;按违反等级比较计划;按总成本来打破联系。 由此产生的最佳向量是金色注解,只有当其溶液与矢量相匹配时,其价位和成本才是正确的. 语言提示和基准构建细节的完整清单载于附录F。

blocks.en: 4.2 Original Construction of LexiBench
blocks.zh: 4.2 Lexi Bench的原始建筑

blocks.en: Figure 2: Priority annotation in LexiBench instances. Arrows indicate priority ordering: left is a higher priority than right.
blocks.zh: 图 2: Lexi Bench案的优先注释。 箭头表示优先级排序:左为优先级高于右.

blocks.en: LexiBench is an original dataset of 75 problems that tests richer ordered preferences than the preceding sources, which contain either fixed weights or at most three tiers. Figure 2 shows its five preference structures. Each structure is instantiated for three decision types. Atomic problems select one element from a candidate set, as in COMPASS. Assembly problems build a bundle from several candidate sets, as in TravelPlanner. Constructive problems formulate constraints and optimize over an implicitly defined feasible region, as in conventional hard-constraint benchmarks. Hardness is signaled with the same modal cues as TravelPlanner, and when more than three levels are needed, explicit comparatives such as “more important than,” “higher priority,” and “above all” fix the remaining order. Gold is computed by enumeration for atomic and assembly problems and by solving the annotated lexicographic model in Gurobi for constructive problems. A formulation is correct if it attains the gold objective vector, regardless of which optimal solution it returns.
blocks.zh: Lexi Bench是75个问题的原始数据集,测试比前几个来源更丰富的订单偏好,它们要么包含固定的权重,要么最多三层. 图2显示其五个优惠结构。 每种结构为三种决定类型即时化. 原子问题从一组候选人中选择一个要素,如COMPAS。 如《旅行规划》中那样,议会问题从几个候选人组中产生一个捆绑。 建设性问题形成制约,并优化一个隐含定义的可行区域,如常规硬约束基准。 硬度用与旅行规划员相同的模式提示来表示,在需要三个以上级别时,如“比”、“更优先”和“高于所有”等明确的比较确定其余的顺序。 黄金的计算是通过原子和组装问题的计数和通过解决古罗比的附加说明的词典模型来解决建设性问题。 如果配方达到黄金目标向量,无论它返回哪种最佳解决方案,都是正确的.

blocks.en: The priority signal column of Table 1 records how each source communicates priority, and Appendix A disaggregates accuracy by it. Explicit sources state priority in words that name a level directly, such as “strongly prefer” and “slightly prefer” in Nurse Rostering or “equally important” in COMPASS. Modal sources encode priority only through the modal verbs above, so the tier must be inferred from the strength of the wording. Mixed sources, namely LexiBench, combine modal cues with explicit comparatives and pairwise statements, so recovering the ordering requires both readings. Appendix F gives the complete construction and annotation procedures for SoftOR.
blocks.zh: 表1的优先信号栏记录了每个来源如何传达优先级,附录A按其精确度分列. 明确来源用直接指代某一级别的话语表示优先权,如护士名册中的“强烈偏好”和“略偏好”或COMPAS中的“同等重要”等。 Modal源只通过上方模式动词来编码优先权,所以从措辞强度上必须推断出分级. 混合来源,即Lexi Bench,将模式提示与明确的比较和对等语句相结合,因此恢复订单需要两种读取. 附 录 F给出了SoftOR的完整构造和注释程序.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: To evaluate ASTOR, we compare it with single-request prompting methods and previously published agentic autoformulation methods across hard and soft constraint benchmarks. Our experiments address the following research questions: • RQ1: How accurately do single-request and multi-agent inference methods solve soft-constraint benchmarks? How does this performance differ by lexicographic and weighted penalty objectives? • RQ2: How does accuracy vary by priority signal and problem difficulty? • RQ3: What technical and solution errors do the methods produce? • RQ4: How expensive is ASTOR compared to other methods? • RQ5: How do the ASTOR components and backbone affect performance?
blocks.zh: 为了评价ASTOR,我们把它与单要求催化方法和以前公布的代理自制方法进行比较,这些方法跨越了硬和软约束基准。 我们的实验涉及以下研究问题: • RQ1:单方请求和多剂推论方法如何准确解决软约束基准? 词汇学和加权惩罚目标之间这种表现有何不同? • RQ2:精确度如何因优先信号和问题难度而异? • RQ3:这些方法产生了哪些技术和解决方案错误? • RQ4:与其他方法相比,ASTOR成本多高? • RQ5:ASTOR组件和骨干如何影响性能?

blocks.en: RQ1: How accurately do single-request and multi-agent inference methods solve soft-constraint benchmarks? How does this performance differ by lexicographic and weighted penalty objectives?
blocks.zh: RQ1:单方请求和多剂推论方法如何准确解决软约束基准?. 词汇学和加权惩罚目标之间这种表现有何不同?

blocks.en: RQ2: How does accuracy vary by priority signal and problem difficulty?
blocks.zh: RQ2:精确度如何因优先信号和问题难度而异?

blocks.en: RQ3: What technical and solution errors do the methods produce?
blocks.zh: RQ3:这些方法产生了哪些技术和解决方案错误?

blocks.en: RQ4: How expensive is ASTOR compared to other methods?
blocks.zh: RQ4:与其他方法相比,ASTOR成本多高?

blocks.en: RQ5: How do the ASTOR components and backbone affect performance?
blocks.zh: RQ5:ASTOR组件和骨干如何影响性能?

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: For our main experiment, we evaluate on SoftOR using temperature-zero Gemini 3.7 Flash as the LLM backbone with the provider-default thinking configuration on most benchmarks. The only exception is Nurse Rostering, where all routes receive an increased thinking budget and use Gemini 3.8 Flash, due to its more complex formulations. Appendix A includes additional experiments on standard autoformulation benchmarks distributed by Yang et al. (2026) , but these include almost exclusively hard constraints. A non-reasoning model, a non-Gemini reasoning model, and a larger Gemini reasoning model are included in later ablation studies on SoftOR and standard benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 对于我们的主要实验,我们用温度为零的双子座 3.7 Flash作为LLM主干线,在SoftOR上评价大多数基准上的提供者-默认思维配置. 唯一的例外是"护士"(Nurse Clointing),由于配方较为复杂,所有路线都获得更多的思维预算并使用双子座3.8 Flash. 附 录 A包括由杨等(2026年)所分配的标准自发性基准的额外实验,但这些实验包括几乎完全严格的限制. 一个非理性模型,一个非格米尼推理模型,以及一个更大的双子座推理模型,都包含在后期关于SoftOR和标准基准的研究中.

blocks.en: Solution Accuracy , as defined in Section 2 , is the primary evaluation metric, and other metrics are reported in Table 3 for more granularity on which soft constraints are most often satisfied. Since lexicographic problems have multiple objectives, gold-standard labels are vectors, and LLM formulations are considered correct if and only if the entire lexicographic objective vector produced matches the gold-standard one within the specified numerical tolerance. Weighted-penalty problems have a single objective, so the gold standard label is a number, and similarly, formulations are correct if and only if the number produced matches the gold-standard value within the specified numerical tolerance.
blocks.zh: 如第2节所定义,解决办法准确性是主要评价指标,其他指标则在表3中报告,说明软约束最能满足的更颗粒性。 由于词典学问题有多个目标,金标准标签是矢量,而LLM配体只有在整个词典学目标矢量在指定的数值可容性范围内与金标准相匹配的情况下才被认为正确. 重刑问题有一个单一的目标,因此金本位标签是一个数字,类似地,如果并且只有在所生产的数字与指定的数字容能范围内的金本位值相匹配时,配方才是正确的.

blocks.en: We compare against three single-request routes using the same backbone model. Direct is given the natural language problem and predicts the final answer with no intermediate representation. Code-generation (Codegen) is a single-request LLM prompting method which is given the natural language problem and outputs executable Gurobi code to solve the problem ( Deng et al., 2024 ) . This is the main control of the experiment, and tests whether a formal grammar provides any advantage over another formal intermediate representation, like solver code. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) asks the LLM to think in steps to produce a mathematical optimization model and executable Gurobi code ( Wei et al., 2022 ) . ORThought uses agents to formulate the optimization problem as executable code and at most three repair agents to debug the formulation or code ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Chain-of-Experts (CoE) uses a panel of many LLM agents to collaborate on formulation, coding, and natural-language extraction ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) . ORThought and CoE use published prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三条使用同一种主干模型的单一请求路线. Direct被赋予了自然语言问题,并预测没有中间代表的最终答案. 代码生成(Codegen)是一种单请求的LLM提示方法,它赋予自然语言问题和输出可执行的Gurobi代码以解决问题(Deng等,2024年). 这是实验的主要控制,并测试一个正文法是否比另一个正文中间代表提供了任何优势,如解码. Cain-of-Thought(COT)要求LLM在步骤中思考,以产生一个数学优化模型和可执行的古罗比代码(Wei等,2022年). orThought使用代理来制定优化问题作为可执行代码,并最多3个修理代理来调试配制或代码(Yang等,2026.). 连锁-专家(CoE)使用由许多LLM剂组成的面板在配制,编码,和自然语言取出方面进行合作(Xiao等,2024. 欧洲委员会出版的通告。

blocks.en: Direct, Codegen, and CoT are single-request LLM prompting methods, whereas CoE and ORThought are multi-request pipelines that use different LLM prompts for formulation, repair, and execution. We estimate sampling uncertainty with 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples over problem instances, using the same sampled instances for every method. Tables report bootstrap standard errors in parentheses, and figures show percentile 95% confidence intervals. Appendix D gives the prompts.
blocks.zh: Direct、Codegen和CoT是单一请求的LLM提示方法,而EC和ORTHET是多请求管道,使用不同的LLM提示来进行配制、修理和执行。 我们用10 000对靴子重新标出的问题实例来估计取样不确定性,对每一种方法都采用同样的抽样实例。 表格在括号中报告拖曳标准错误,数字显示95%的置信间隔。 附录D给出了提示。

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ1: Accuracy
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ1: 准确性

blocks.en: Overall, ASTOR is the most accurate on SoftOR, with an aggregate accuracy across lexicographic and weighted penalty problems of 88.5%. From most to least accurate, the baselines achieve 84.8% for CoE, 83.7% for Codegen, 81.4% for CoT, 80.0% for ORThought, and 52.7% for Direct. blocks.en: We analyze technical and solution errors as percentages of all evaluated attempts. Technical errors include malformed outputs, parsing, compilation, or execution failures. blocks.en: ASTOR has the lowest error rate (i.e., percent of instances with either technical or solution errors) on SoftOR among the compared methods (Figure 3 ). The whiskers show 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the total error rate, combining technical and solution errors, and the unplotted remainder up to 100% represents correct attempts. On LexiBench, Codegen and CoT often satisfy the right preferences but fail to choose the cheapest solution among equally preferred options, accounting for 5 of Codegen’s 8 solution errors and 10 of CoT’s 12. ASTOR instead gives up preferences to reduce cost in five of its six errors because it combines preference penalties and cost in a weighted sum. In the remaining case, it gives the highest priorities to the wishes the request explicitly says to give up first. On the hard-constraint benchmarks, error rates are similar for ASTOR, Codegen, CoT, ORThought, and CoE, for which full details are included in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 5.6 RQ5: Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.6 RQ5:发育研究

blocks.en: We examine the prompt components and LLM backbone of ASTOR. Following precedent for analysis on fixed benchmark subsets ( Song et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) , we construct a frozen, stratified 100-instance sample drawn from the eight benchmarks, including the four from SoftOR and four hard-constraint-only benchmarks in Appendix A . All main-text ablations report results on the 45 soft-constraint instances included in the sample, while Appendix A reports the corresponding results on the complementary 55 hard-constraint instances. For every ablation except the LLM backbone, the same settings as the main experiment are applied to each dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们检查了ASTOR的快速组件和LLM骨干. 按照对固定基准子集进行分析的先例(Song等人,2026年;Lu等人,2025年;Yao等人,2025年),我们构建了一个从8个基准中抽取的被冻结的、分级的100倍样本,包括来自SoftOR的4个和附录A中4个严格限制的基准。 所有主文拼贴报告都对样本中包含的45个软约束实例得出了结果,而附录A报告了补充性55个硬约束实例的相应结果。 除LLM主干线外,每条通断口,每个数据集都应用与主实验相同的设置.

blocks.en: As seen in Appendix D , the ASTOR prompt has several components, and we remove one for each ablation. The ASTOR prompt includes the formal grammar in two parts, one as a human-readable markdown file in the style of a BNF grammar, and the other as a JSON schema that specifies the expected form of the output. It also supplies a benchmark contract, with bespoke information needed to use the data of each benchmark. Lastly, ASTOR uses a deterministic Python code repair which detects and fixes syntax mistakes in the JSON output, for which more information is available in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 如附录D所显示,ASTOR 提示有多个组件,我们删除每个激发的一个组件。 ASTOR快取包括了形式语法分两部分,一是作为BNF语法风格中的可被人读取的标记下文件;一是作为JSON schema来指定输出的预期形式. 它还提供一份基准合同,其中附有使用每个基准的数据所需的发言信息。 最后,ASTOR使用一种确定性的Python代码修复,它检测并修正了JSON输出中的语法错误,附录A对此有更多信息.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: SoftOR makes soft-constraint autoformulation measurable through weighted penalties, lexicographic objectives, and solver-verified gold annotations, and ASTOR shows that a formal intermediate language improves accuracy on exactly those problems, particularly ordered preferences, while remaining competitive on hard constraints. Future work should define and evaluate on a metric of faithfulness to the original optimization problem or solver performance and extend the benchmark with less explicit language to test how well the method transfers to those settings. Overall, the results support formal languages and ASTs as practical foundations for optimization autoformulation.
blocks.zh: 软 OR通过加权罚则,词汇目标,解析器验证金注等方法,使软约束自发性可计量,而ASTOR则显示,正式的中间语言可以提高这些问题的准确性,特别是订货偏好,同时在硬约束上保持竞争力. 今后的工作应当界定和评价对原始优化问题或解决者业绩的忠诚度,并用不太明确的语言扩大基准,以测试方法向这些环境的转让情况。 总的来说,成果支持将正式语言和AST作为优化自动格式的实际基础。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work does not involve human subjects, personal data, or sensitive attributes, so institutional review board approval was not required. SoftOR is built from publicly released benchmarks (COMPASS, TravelPlanner, and SchedulingBenchmarks) under their original licenses, together with LexiBench, an original dataset written and annotated by the authors. All priority annotations, gold constructions, and error labels were produced by the authors following the protocols in Appendices E and F , and no crowdsourcing or paid annotation was used. The natural-language instances describe scheduling, travel, and staffing scenarios with fictional entities and contain no real individuals. Experiments call commercial LLM APIs, and the available token usage and cost of every reported run are recorded in Appendix A at the prices listed in Appendix D so that the environmental and financial footprint of the study is visible. The methods and benchmark are intended to make optimization formulation more faithful to stated preferences and carry no foreseeable dual-use risk beyond that of general-purpose optimization tooling. The authors have no conflicts of interest or sponsorship to declare.
blocks.zh: 这项工作不涉及人主体,个人数据,或敏感属性,因此不需要机构审查委员会的批准. 软 其他资源是根据公开发布的基准(COMPAS、Travel Planner和 Scheduling Benchmarks)以及作者撰写和注释的Lexi Bench根据原始许可证建立的。 所有优先说明,黄金构造,和错误标签都是作者按照附录E和F中的协议制作的,没有使用众包或付费注释. 自然语言的例子描述的是虚构实体的时间安排、旅行和人员配置情况,没有真正的个人。 实验称为商业LLM API, 附录A按附录D所列价格记录了每一次报告运行的现有象征性使用量和成本,从而可见研究的环境和财务足迹。 这些方法和基准旨在使优化表述更加忠实于所述偏好,除普通用途优化工具外,没有可预见的双重用途风险。 提交人无利益冲突或担保可申报。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: We release the complete ASTOR pipeline, the SoftOR benchmark with its gold annotations, all prompts, and the raw outputs and evaluation records of every reported run as supplementary material and at the repository linked in the abstract. The formal grammar, the definition of the problem class, and the full proof of adequacy are in Appendix C , and Appendix B works one instance through the pipeline with its literal compiler trace. Appendix D gives the exact prompts for the four single-request routes, the configuration and prompt provenance of ORThought and CoE, the benchmark contracts, the execution and evaluation rules, the frozen decoding and pricing settings, and the ablation definitions. The identifiers of the frozen 100-instance ablation subset are available through the repository. Appendix F documents every dataset adaptation, including the TravelPlanner priority rules, the LexiBench construction, the Nurse Rostering phrase mapping, the COMPASS templates, and the gold-label corrections applied to the ORThought releases. Section 5.1 states the backbone, decoding settings, and bootstrap protocol, and Appendix E gives the error-labeling decision order.

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to generate the natural-language instances of SoftOR by applying a dataset-construction procedure that the authors designed without AI, to clean and reformat source datasets, and to assist in the exposition of author-developed adequacy proofs in Appendix C , but not with formulating the mathematical claims. It was also used to provide feedback on the experimental design, and to implement the ablation experiments. We have not used generative AI tools to develop the conceptual framework or the formal grammar, to propose or refine hypotheses, to design the methodology, or to interpret results. Translation and qualitative or thematic analysis are not applicable to this work. Additionally, we used generative AI tools to create and edit software code, to create scientific figures, to brainstorm, to edit the paper for readability, and to format references. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

blocks.en: Figure 9 repeats the component ablations of Section 5.6 with the hard-constraint strata alongside the soft-constraint strata shown in the main text. Deterministic repair uses fixed rules in Python to fix local syntax errors in the model’s JSON output before parsing and compilation, without making another LLM call. Figure 10 summarizes the compositional rules of an example grammar constructed for this problem. The complete

list of named constraints. Expressions are built from constants, symbols and
indexed symbols, combined with arithmetic operators, a small set of functions,
and aggregation over an index set. A formula either compares two expressions or
joins other formulas with the usual connectives.

terms are folded into that one expression. Objective( sense , ⟨ \,\langle Tier ⟩ \rangle ,…) takes an
ordered list of tiers, each carrying its own expression, and a lexicographic
model uses that form instead. This lets an evaluator tell two formulations apart by looking at
the tree, without going back to the natural language.

blocks.en: Let 𝒪 \mathcal{O} be the class of finite optimization problems over binary, integer, real, bounded, or finite categorical decision domains. Hard constraints and objectives are formed by finite compositions of constants, indexed quantities, arithmetic and elementary functions, norms, conditionals, piecewise-linear functions, finite aggregations, comparisons, Boolean connectives, and quantification over finite index sets. A problem may additionally contain nonnegative soft-constraint violations combined by either weighted penalties or a finite lexicographic priority ordering.

blocks.en:
A sort is the type of value represented by a node, such as an integer, real number, Boolean value, string, or element of a declared finite set. An AST is well-sorted when every operation is applied to inputs of the appropriate types. For example, arithmetic operations require numeric inputs, a comparison of two numeric expressions produces a Boolean-valued condition, and a quantified index must range over a declared finite set. An AST is well-formed if its construction does not contradict the rules of G G and if all references and indices are valid, expressions and aggregations are defined wherever evaluated, piecewise constructions are unambiguous, and priority annotations and relations determine ordered tiers for all
soft constraints, allowing ties. A partial ordering that leaves a
constraint’s tier unresolved is insufficient.

blocks.en: The inductive hypothesis is that every child Expr or DataExpr is well-sorted and every child Formula or DataFormula is Boolean-valued. Proceeding to the parent, an operation applies a typed operator to compatible expressions; a conditional selects between compatible branches using a Boolean condition; and an aggregation combines well-sorted values over a declared finite domain. A comparison , membership , logical , or quantifier node returns a Boolean value when applied to children of the required sorts. By the inductive hypothesis and the typing requirements of G G , the parent is therefore well-sorted if it is an expression and Boolean-valued if it is a formula. This completes the induction.

blocks.en: E.1.1 Soft Constraints

blocks.en: On LexiBench, ASTOR returns hard-feasible solutions on all 75 instances, but six have incorrect preference outcomes. Five of these use weighted-sum aggregation with a cost objective, while the sixth assigns higher priority to preferences that the request explicitly says to sacrifice first. Among the local constraints in the 180 evaluated TravelPlanner instances, ASTOR treats 17 of 124 preferences as hard constraints and 5 of 116 hard constraints as preferences. Treating a preference as hard was harmless in 11 of the 17 cases, and treating a hard constraint as a preference never caused a failure.
blocks.zh: 在Lexi Bench上,ASTOR在所有75个实例中都返回了硬可行的解决方案,但有6个有错误的偏好结果. 其中5项采用成本目标的加权总和,而第6项则更优先考虑请求明确要求首先牺牲的偏好。 在180个受到评价的旅行规划者案例中,地方制约因素中,ASTOR将124个优惠中的17个作为硬限制,将116个硬限制中的5个作为优惠。 在17个案例中,将优惠视为硬性是无害的,将硬性约束视为优惠从来不会导致失败。

blocks.en: ASTOR has 41 unsuccessful attempts on SoftOR: 27 on TravelPlanner, 6 on LexiBench, 7 on Nurse Rostering, and 1 on COMPASS. Of these, 1 is a technical failure and 40 are classified as solution errors by the evaluator. All seven unsuccessful Nurse Rostering attempts return hard-feasible rosters, with published-weight penalties between 1 and 4 points above the gold optimum. Lexicographic mistakes include wrong preference tiers or misdiagnosing a soft constraint as hard. Some examples: In the laptop instance, five equal wishes are followed by “the cheaper one wins”; ASTOR kept all five wishes but summed them with price, and satisfied three instead of four. In the service-vehicle instance, the text ranks wishes as “we would sooner run without X X than without Y Y ”; ASTOR reversed the order. In the makerspace instance, the top wish is “the one thing we will not trade”; ASTOR made it a hard constraint.
blocks.zh: ASTOR对Softor公司进行了41次不成功的尝试:27次是旅行计划员,6次是Lexi Bench,7次是护士名册编制,1次是COMPAS。 其中1起为技术故障,40起被评估者归类为溶液出错. 所有7个未成功的护士名册编制尝试都退回了难以操作的名册,公布的重量级处罚比黄金最佳值高1至4分。 词汇学错误包括错误的偏好等级或误判软约束为硬. 一些例子: 在笔记本电脑中,5个平等的愿望之后是“更便宜的一方获胜”;ASTOR保留了所有5个愿望,但以价格概括,并满足了3个而不是4个。 在服务车辆方面,案文希望“我们越早没有X X 而不是没有Y Y ”;ASTOR推翻了这一命令。 在制造空间的例子中,最高的愿望是“我们不会交易的一件事”;ASTOR使它成为一个严格的制约。

blocks.en: When a method gets a soft-constraint problem wrong, it is usually not because it missed a preference. It often treats one preference as too strict, or mixes the preferences together the wrong way. The baselines often end up minimizing cost instead of respecting the priority order, so a cheap plan wins even when it skips something more important. ASTOR’s mistakes go the other way: it sometimes turns a preference into a hard rule, or lets cost outweigh a preference it should have kept.
blocks.zh: 当一种方法得到软约束问题错误时,通常不是因为它错过了偏好. 它常常将一种偏好视为过于严格,或者把偏好混为一谈是错误的。 基线往往会降低成本,而不是尊重优先秩序,因此,廉价计划即使跳过了更重要的事情,也会获胜。 ASTOR的错误是相反的:它有时会把偏好变成硬规则,或者让成本超过它应该保持的偏好。

blocks.en: E.1.2 Hard Constraints
blocks.zh: E.1.2 硬制约因素

blocks.en: On the hard-constraint benchmarks, a wrong answer is almost always a wrong objective value rather than a failed solve. A value better than gold means the method was able to achieve a lower value for a minimization objective or a higher value for a maximization objective than the annotated gold-standard optimum, and a value worse than gold means the opposite. Dropped constraints are the more common error for every method, by about two to one: Codegen returns 47 values better than gold and 22 worse, CoT 51 and 23, ORThought 55 and 22, CoE 46 and 24, and ASTOR 43 and 17, the fewest over-constrained formulations. Direct, which solves by hand, returns 71 better and 31 worse. Infeasible or unbounded formulations are rare, at most 3 per method.
blocks.zh: 在硬约束的基准上,错误的答案几乎总是错误的客观价值而不是失败的解决方案. 优于黄金的值意味着该方法能够实现最小化目标的更低值或最大化目标的更高值,比附加说明的黄金标准最佳值更差的值则意味着相反. 滴出的限制是每种方法中更常见的错误,大约从2到1: Codegen 返回47个数值优于金而22更差; CoT 51和23; ORTHET 55和22; CE 46和24;以及 ASTOR 43和17, 最少数超限的配方. Direct,通过手解决,返回71更好和31更差. 不可行或无约束的配方很少见,每方法最多有3种.

blocks.en: When a method gets a hard-constraint problem wrong, it is almost always because it left out a constraint, not because it added one that was not there. That makes the solver report a better answer than is actually allowed. It is rare for a method to end up with an infeasible or over-constrained model instead. The grammar does not stop constraints from getting dropped, but when one does get dropped, it is more likely to show up as an obvious error instead of a wrong answer that looks right.
blocks.zh: 当一个方法得到一个硬约束问题错误时,它几乎总是因为它忽略了一个约束,而不是因为它增加了一个不存在的制约. 这使得解答者的报告比实际允许的更好. 一种方法以不可行或过紧的模型取而代之是罕见的. 语法并没有阻止限制被放弃,但是当一个人确实被放弃时,它更可能作为一个明显的错误出现,而不是一个看起来正确的错误答案.

blocks.en: The included instances assign penalties of 100 100 to understaffing and 1 1 to overstaffing. We express this by stating that understaffing is “far more serious” than overstaffing. The numerical penalties are not shown to the model and are only used to evaluate the final roster produced by each method. blocks.en: Note that the request weights 1, 2, 3, 100 are the numbers chosen by the original authors of Nurse Rostering at SchedulingBenchmarks, but those numbers are not unique in determining the preference order. For example, 3, 14, 86, and 1592 would create the same ordering. As a result, for our newly constructed natural language instances which only signal request strength through linguistic cues, it is precisely the task of each method to be able to infer and instantiate numerical weights which reflect the strength of the given language. In the weighted penalty experiments we never show the original weights of 1, 2, 3, 100 to the models, and allow them to choose their own numbers or whether to use weights at all. After doing this, they will produce a nurse roster for this problem, which specifies which nurses work on which days using indicator decision variables. We only use the original weights 1, 2, 3, 100 after the decision is made for the sake of evaluation: to accrue the penalty of each roster by noting when the chosen decision violates staffing and shift preferences, and multiplying by their weights in accordance with the original SchedulingBenchmarks gold-standard calculation.

blocks.en: The remaining measures are also calculated separately for each roster: Understaffing = missing required nurse–shift positions total required nurse–shift positions . \text{Understaffing}=\frac{\text{missing required nurse--shift positions}}{\text{total required nurse--shift positions}}. Overstaffing = assignments above staffing requirements total required nurse–shift positions . \text{Overstaffing}=\frac{\text{assignments above staffing requirements}}{\text{total required nurse--shift positions}}. Weighted Preference Violation = total weight of violated shift requests total weight of all shift requests . \text{Weighted Preference Violation}=\frac{\text{total weight of violated shift requests}}{\text{total weight of all shift requests}}. Understaffing and overstaffing may both be nonzero because different shifts can fall below and exceed their requirements. Table 19 reports the complements of these three measures, so that higher is better in every column: staffing coverage is one minus understaffing or overstaffing, and weighted preference satisfied is one minus weighted preference violation. Each of the 15 instances receives equal weight in its method’s reported average, and an attempt with no decodable roster counts as satisfying no constraint.

blocks.en: Currently, the version of Nurse Rostering we use has each route infer and instantiate its own penalty weights, and only uses author-published weights for calculating penalties for the final scoring. We chose this setup because our main question is whether methods can turn natural-language preferences into decisions. Supplying the numerical weights before optimization would provide part of the preference interpretation that we want the methods to perform. As an ablation, we ran a version of Nurse Rostering that allowed methods to see weights before decision-making, using the same experimental settings as the main Nurse Rostering experiment. Direct sees numerical weights associated with natural language directly in the prompt, and all other routes use variable placeholders for each weight, which are deterministically replaced with the actual weights 1, 2, 3, or 100 when the code is generated, before running it to find an optimal solution. The results are presented in the Table 21 , which should be read in the same way as Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 目前,我们使用的"护士名册"(Nurse Walkering)版本有每一条路线推断并即时分出其自身的罚分权重,并且只使用作者公布的权重来计算最终得分的罚分. 我们选择这个设置是因为我们的主要问题是,方法是否能够把自然语言偏好变成决定. 在优化前提供数字加权数,将提供我们希望方法执行的部分偏好解释. 作为禁忌,我们运行了一个版本的护士名册化,允许方法在决策前看到重量,使用与主护士名册化实验相同的实验设置. Direct看到与自然语言直接相接的数值权重在即时,而所有其他通路则使用可变的占位符来表示每个权重,在生成代码时,这些占位符是决定性地被实际权重1,2,3或100所取代的,然后运行以找到最佳的解决方案. 结果载于表21,表21应与表4相同。

Nurse rostering is still challenging in this setting: some methods violate hard constraints or fail to return an evaluable roster consistently.
